name: Freshly Baked Plain Tandoori Naan Bread
whyItWorks: Slapped against the fiery walls of a traditional clay tandoor oven, plain naan made with refined wheat flour bakes up light, fluffy, and tender. It provides gut-soothing starch without seeds, herbs, or irritating garlic.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Specify PLAIN naan without butter glaze or minced garlic. Tear into small pieces to accompany mild curries or basmati rice.
